summary: The 203-episode anime adapts manga chapters 1-282 (through the end of the Future arc, vol 30; continue at 283), but the Daily Life gag chapters (1-61) are shuffled and split into four blocks (eps 1-19, 27-33, 38-39, 66-73) with chapters 5-6, 17-18, 43-47 and 61 never adapted, while Kokuyo (62-81 = eps 20-26), Varia (82-135 = eps 34-65) and the Future arc (136-282 = eps 74-141, 155-177, 190-203) are linear at ~2 chapters per episode. Two anime-only arcs interrupt the Future arc - Arcobaleno Trials (142-153, plus recap 154) and Primo Family (178-189) - and ep 155 re-adapts 227-228 after the first one; ja.wikipedia, the fandom arc pages and vongola101 agree on every arc boundary. Per-episode chapter lists come from the fandom episode infoboxes (the only per-episode table online); 36 anchors are 'high' (END chapter corroborated by Wikipedia chapter-title matches, multi-source arc boundaries or AFG/mangashed), the rest 'medium'. Surprises: eps 111-112 are built around anime-only opponents (Cappuccino, Arachide Brothers) confirmed anime-original by ja.wikipedia (type correction to mixed); ep 93 and ep 177 look mostly anime-original/recap but have only one source (flagged); fandom is one chapter off for eps 91-92 and under-lists ep 102, corrected from the chapter synopses. The existing ep 203 -> 282 anchor is confirmed (AFG, mangashed, fandom).

annotations.note: Daily Life gag chapters are adapted out of order and split into blocks: eps 1-19, then 27-33 (after Kokuyo), 38-39 (inside the Varia arc), 66-73 (after Varia). Anime order of chapters: 1 | 2-3(+5) | 7-10 | 11-12 | 16 | 23-24 | 14 | 27-28 | 15 | 21 | 25 | 32,39 | 31 | 42 | 37-38 | 30 | 29 | 36 | 34-35 || 20 | 19 | 41? | 48 | 49-50 | 54 | 57-58 || 56,59 | 52-53 || 60 | 33 | 51 | 26 | 13 | 40 | 4 | 22+55. Never adapted: 5 (merged into ep 2), 6, 17-18, 43-47 (Longchamp Naito / Tomaso Family chapters), 61 (fandom episode infoboxes; vongola101 and the ja.wikipedia episode-table headers agree the blocks are Daily Life material, including the note 38・39は日常編 for the two episodes inside the Varia block). Each episode pads a ~19-page gag chapter to 22 minutes with anime-original material.
Yamamoto's manga introduction (ch 5 'Takeshi Yamamoto') is folded into ep 2 alongside ch 2-3 (fandom Daily Life Arc page).
Ch 30 'Lost' is shown (ep 16) before ch 29 'Hospitalized' (ep 17); the Enzio-crushing scene from ch 29 is moved into ep 16 (fandom ep 16/17 trivia).
Ch 20 'Eat and Run' wrapped in an anime-original grade-promotion / class-roster contest; ch 61 'Promotion' (Gokudera/Dino) is not adapted despite the episode title.

Mixed episodes with only loose manga basis: ep 29 'possibly ch 41' (fandom), ep 73 combines ch 22 'Birthday Party' and ch 55 'The Tanabata Contest' with the party host, judge, winners and cast all changed (fandom Manga & Anime Differences).
The 'Absolute Evil Fist' technique is anime-original (ja.wikipedia: アニメオリジナル, 標的71); the dojo-buster premise is ch 40.
Ep 44 opens on the tail of ch 98 (Tsuna's intervention) before covering 99; fandom lists 97-99 for ep 44 because of the recap.
Ep 91 ends on the first appearance of 10-years-later Ryohei (opening of 166); ep 92 covers 166-167. Fandom infoboxes ('164, 166' / '165-166') run one chapter behind the episode and chapter synopses.

Dellinger-phenomenon / Lambo-and-I-Pin-trapped plot is anime-original padding around the Lal Mirch sickness and Leonardo Lippi threads of ch 167-168 (single source: fandom synopses; typed canon in our rows).
Training-completion material of ch 173 is stretched over eps 98-99; ep 102 straddles 175/176 (Hibari's lure, then the duct entry and laser trap of ch 176) although fandom lists only 175 for it.

Anime-original Millefiore opponents Ape (ep 84), Giaggiolo (ep 85), Cappuccino / Octopus Head (ep 111) and the Arachide Brothers / Storm Boomerang (ep 112): ja.wikipedia marks their box weapons アニメオリジナル匣 and the fandom Future Arc page lists all four as filler characters. Eps 111-112 keep only slivers of ch 189-190 (base rearrangement; Gokudera and Ryohei meet Gamma).
The Ginger Bread / Iris search for Spanner (ch 201) is pulled forward into ep 122 alongside the start of Yamamoto vs Genkishi (198).
The Real Six Funeral Wreaths reveal (227-228) is shown in ep 140, padded in ep 141, and re-adapted in ep 155 after the anime-only Arcobaleno Trials before the story continues at 229.

Arcobaleno Trials arc (142-153) is anime-original (ja.wikipedia: アニメオリジナルのシリーズ 標的142-153, supervised by Amano; fandom Arcobaleno Trials Arc page; vongola101); ep 154 is a recap of the Merone Base battles.

Primo Family arc (178-189) is anime-original (ja.wikipedia: アニメオリジナル 標的178-189; fandom Primo Family Arc page; vongola101 'Primo famiglia trials'); eps 178 and 189 are mixed bookends touching ch 257. It pre-empts manga material (Daemon Spade's betrayal, first revealed in ch 318; Giotto's pocket watches, ch 344).
Recap-heavy episodes: 119 (mixed), 154 (recap), 177 (Reborn recaps the Choice arc to Lal Mirch; typed canon in our rows), 189 (mixed recap).
Ep 198 inserts a flashback to ch 262 (Uni / Torikabuto) while covering 270-271 (fandom infobox: 262, 270, 271).

type_corrections.note: Typed canon in our rows, but the on-screen fights (Cappuccino's Octopus Head in 111, the Arachide Brothers' Storm Boomerang in 112) are against anime-only characters with anime-original box weapons; only slivers of ch 189-190 remain (base rearrangement, meeting Gamma).

structure.notes: Single AniList entry 1604 covers all 203 TV episodes; our cumulative numbering equals the broadcast 標的 (Target) numbering, so no conversion was needed for any source (fandom 'Episode N', ja.wikipedia 標的N, animefillerlist, animefillerguide all use the same numbers). On-air arc blocks per ja.wikipedia episode-table headers (which also mark 142-153 and 178-189 アニメオリジナルストーリー and 38-39 as Daily Life) / subtitle cards: Daily Life 1-19; vs Kokuyo 20-26; Daily Life 27-33; vs Varia 34-65; Daily Life 66-73; Future 74-141; Arcobaleno (anime-only) 142-153; Future Choice 154-177; Primo Family (anime-only) 178-189; Future Final Battle 190-203. Manga arc spans (fandom arc pages, vongola101 agrees within one chapter): Daily Life 1-61, Kokuyo 62-81, Varia 82-135, Future 136-282; the anime ends at ch 282 (vol 30), continue at 283 = Inheritance Ceremony arc (animefillerguide, mangashed) - consistent with the entry's continue_from_chapter 283.
